calculationFlow: Average household refill frequency: ~7 cylinders/year (rural) to ~10 (urban) = blended 8-9 cylinders/year.
Annual cylinder refills: 32 crore × 8.5 = ~270 crore refills/year.
Daily: ~74 lakh refills/day = ~7.4 million cylinders refilled per day.
Plus commercial (19 kg) cylinders: ~30-40 lakh refills/year = ~10K/day.
